capabilities: Export story folders as Shunn-format .docx files
Combine multiple notes into scenes with scene breaks
Configure author name and contact info via settings or note properties
Override title, filename and output directory per story
disambiguation: Not a story-writing or drafting tool; it only exports existing notes from a story folder into a formatted .docx file.
extras: Warns that note ordering breaks with plugins like Custom File Explorer sorting; a related project (Manuscriptum manuscript format) is referenced but documented elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn story notes into the standard .docx manuscript format that fiction markets require for submissions.
summary: Exports story notes as Microsoft Word .docx manuscripts in the Shunn format, ready for submission to magazines or agents.
